decision: Shared infrastructure for dev and prod is the project rule; the operator client is added to the shared Keycloak realm without touching existing clients, users or prod configuration.

client.type: confidential, service account only (client_credentials); standard/implicit/password flows disabled
client.tenantId: geostat (service-account user attribute via the realm 'tenant' client scope)
mappers: oidc-usermodel-realm-role-mapper -> realm_access.roles (assigned roles only, no hardcoded claims)

operations.rotate: kcadm.sh create clients/<id>/client-secret -r geostat, then update .env.dev
operations.disable: kcadm.sh update clients/<id> -r geostat -s enabled=false (tokens stop being issued; issued tokens expire within 300 s)
